importance.tip: 詞類觀念是文法基礎，雖不直接出題但影響所有文法判斷

unitStrategy.examinerPerspective: 透過單字選擇或句型改寫間接測驗詞類觀念，較少直接考詞類定義
scoringTips: 理解八大詞類的功能與位置
名詞前可加冠詞，動詞前是主詞
形容詞修飾名詞，副詞修飾動詞/形容詞
commonTraps: 混淆形容詞與副詞用法
忘記不可數名詞不加 a/an
代名詞格的選用錯誤（主格/受格/所有格）
unitStrategy.thinkingPath: 看到詞類題 → 判斷空格在句中的功能（主詞/受詞/修飾語）→ 選出正確詞性

topics.name: 名詞與冠詞
topics.hook: 為什麼「一本書」是 a book 但「一小時」是 an hour？為什麼 water 前面不能加 a？名詞與冠詞的搭配是英文句子的骨架！
coreConcepts: 可數名詞 vs. 不可數名詞：可數名詞有單複數變化（book/books），不可數名詞無複數（water, information, advice, homework）
複數變化規則：加-s（books）、加-es（boxes）、子音+y → ies（cities）、不規則（children, teeth, mice, feet）
冠詞 a/an/the：a + 子音開頭、an + 母音開頭、the 特指已知事物。注意 an hour（h不發音）、a university（u發[ju]）
零冠詞：三餐前（have breakfast）、運動前（play basketball）、科目前（study math）不加冠詞
常考不可數名詞：water, money, information, news, advice, homework, furniture, bread, fruit（水果總稱不可數，指種類時可數 tropical fruits）

pastExamQuestions.question: I need some _____ about the new school. Can you help me?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: information 是不可數名詞，不能加 -s 或 a/an，前面加 some 表示「一些資訊」。

pastExamQuestions.question: There is _____ apple and two bananas on the table.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: apple 以母音 a 開頭，前面要用 an。the 用於特指，此處為初次提及。

pastExamQuestions.question: My teacher gave us a lot of _____ for the weekend. I have so much to do!
pastExamQuestions.explanation: homework 是不可數名詞，用 a lot of 修飾，不能加 -s 或 a/an。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 冠詞與名詞可數性是基礎但高頻考點，常在克漏字或文法選擇題中出現
solvingSteps: 判斷名詞是可數還是不可數
可數名詞看單複數決定冠詞
不可數名詞用 some/much/a lot of 修飾
注意 a 或 an 看發音不看字母
thinkingRules: information, advice, homework, news 永遠不可數
a/an 看「發音」不看「字母」
三餐、運動、科目前不加冠詞

topics.name: 代名詞
topics.hook: 「I love she」哪裡錯了？因為要用受格 her！主格、受格、所有格、反身代名詞——搞清楚代名詞的「格」，句子才寫得對。
coreConcepts: 人稱代名詞四格：主格（I/he/she/we/they）、受格（me/him/her/us/them）、所有格（my/his/her/our/their）、所有代名詞（mine/his/hers/ours/theirs）
主格當主詞、受格當受詞：He loves her.（他愛她）She told him.（她告訴他）
所有格 vs. 所有代名詞：my book = mine，your pen = yours。This book is my book. = This book is mine.
反身代名詞：myself/yourself/himself/herself/ourselves/themselves。用於主詞=受詞時：He hurt himself.
it 的特殊用法：虛主詞 It（It is important to study.）、指天氣/時間（It's raining. / It's 3 o'clock.）

pastExamQuestions.question: This book is not _____. It's my sister's.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 空格後沒有名詞，需要所有代名詞 mine（= my book）。my 後面要接名詞。

pastExamQuestions.question: The children enjoyed _____ at the amusement park yesterday.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: enjoy oneself 表示「玩得開心」。主詞 children（they）的反身代名詞是 themselves。

pastExamQuestions.question: A: Is this your umbrella? B: No, it's not _____. Maybe it's John's.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 問句問「這是你的傘嗎？」回答不是我的（mine = my umbrella）。所有代名詞代替「所有格+名詞」。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 代名詞格的選用是基礎文法題，幾乎每年都考
solvingSteps: 判斷空格在句中的角色（主詞/受詞/修飾名詞）
主詞用主格，受詞用受格
修飾名詞用所有格，代替「所有格+名詞」用所有代名詞
主詞和受詞相同時用反身代名詞
thinkingRules: 空格後有名詞 → 所有格（my book）
空格後沒名詞 → 所有代名詞（It's mine.）
enjoy/help/hurt + oneself 是固定搭配

topics.name: 形容詞與副詞
topics.hook: 他跑得很「快」，是 He runs fast 還是 He runs fastly？其實 fast 本身就可以當副詞！分清形容詞和副詞，是寫出正確英文句子的關鍵。
coreConcepts: 形容詞修飾名詞：放在名詞前（a beautiful flower）或 be 動詞後（The flower is beautiful.）
副詞修飾動詞/形容詞/副詞：She sings beautifully.（修飾動詞）/ very beautiful（修飾形容詞）
形容詞 → 副詞規則：加 -ly（quick → quickly）、-y 結尾改 -ily（happy → happily）、-le 結尾改 -ly（simple → simply）
形副同形字：fast, hard, early, late, high。He runs fast.（副詞）/ a fast car（形容詞）
感官動詞 + 形容詞：look/smell/taste/sound/feel + 形容詞。The cake smells good.（不是 well）

pastExamQuestions.question: The music sounds _____. I like it a lot.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 感官動詞 sound 後面接形容詞（不是副詞），表示「聽起來很美」。

pastExamQuestions.question: My brother drives very _____. He has never had an accident.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: drives 是一般動詞，需要副詞修飾，且語意為小心駕駛，故選 carefully。

pastExamQuestions.question: Please speak _____. The baby is sleeping.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 修飾動詞 speak 要用副詞，寶寶在睡覺要「安靜地」說話，故選 quietly。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 形容詞與副詞的選用是文法基礎題，常透過搭配動詞的方式測驗
solvingSteps: 看空格修飾的對象是名詞還是動詞
修飾名詞 → 形容詞
修飾動詞 → 副詞
注意感官動詞和連綴動詞後接形容詞
thinkingRules: be動詞/感官動詞 + 形容詞，一般動詞 + 副詞
fast, hard, early 形副同形，不加 -ly
good 是形容詞，well 是副詞（但 feel well 可以）

topics.name: 介系詞
topics.hook: 「在星期一」是 on Monday，「在三月」是 in March，「在三點」是 at 3 o'clock——為什麼不同的時間要用不同的介系詞？掌握介系詞的規則，讓你不再亂猜！
coreConcepts: 時間介系詞：at + 時刻（at 7 a.m.）、on + 日期/星期（on Monday / on May 1st）、in + 月份/年/季節（in March / in 2024 / in summer）
地點介系詞：at + 小地點（at school）、in + 大地方/封閉空間（in Taipei / in the room）、on + 表面上（on the table / on the wall）
方向介系詞：to（到）、from（從）、into（進入）、out of（離開）、toward(s)（朝向）
常考搭配：be good at（擅長）、be interested in（對…有興趣）、be afraid of（害怕）、be different from（與…不同）
by/with 的區別：by + 交通工具/方式（by bus / by hand）、with + 工具/人（with a pen / with friends）

pastExamQuestions.question: We will have a picnic _____ Sunday morning if it doesn't rain.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 星期 + 上午/下午/晚上用 on。on Sunday morning。單獨的 morning 用 in the morning。

pastExamQuestions.question: Lisa is very good _____ playing the piano. She practices every day.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: be good at + V-ing：擅長做某事。be good at playing the piano。

pastExamQuestions.question: My school is different _____ my brother's school. His school is much bigger.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: be different from：與…不同。注意不是 different with 或 different to。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 介系詞搭配是每年必考題型，尤其時間介系詞和形容詞搭配介系詞
solvingSteps: 判斷介系詞在句中的功能（時間/地點/搭配）
時間介系詞：at 時刻、on 日期/星期、in 月份/季節/年
地點介系詞：at 小地點、in 大地方、on 表面
固定搭配：回想形容詞/動詞 + 介系詞的慣用組合
thinkingRules: 時間大小原則：in（大）> on（中）> at（小）
be good at / be interested in / be afraid of 是最高頻搭配
on + 星期/日期，但 on Sunday morning（星期+時段仍用 on）

importance.tip: 時態題幾乎每年出3-5題，是文法題的絕對核心

unitStrategy.examinerPerspective: 時態是文法核心考點，測驗學生能否根據時間副詞與語境正確選擇時態
scoringTips: 整理各時態的時間副詞標誌（every day=現在簡單式、yesterday=過去式等）
現在完成式 vs. 過去式是最常考的對比
被動語態公式 be + Vpp 要熟記
commonTraps: 忽略時間副詞直接選答案
現在完成式與過去式混用
被動語態漏掉 be 動詞或用錯時態
unitStrategy.thinkingPath: 看到時態題 → 找時間副詞 → 確認動作完成與否 → 選出正確時態

topics.name: 現在簡單式與現在進行式
topics.hook: 「我每天吃早餐」是 I eat breakfast every day（簡單式），「我正在吃早餐」是 I am eating breakfast now（進行式）。差別就在：習慣 vs. 正在做！
coreConcepts: 現在簡單式：表示習慣、事實、規律。時間副詞：every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never
現在簡單式動詞變化：第三人稱單數加 -s/-es（he goes, she watches）。否定用 doesn't + 原形
現在進行式：be動詞 + V-ing，表示正在進行的動作。時間副詞：now, right now, at the moment, Look!
V-ing 拼寫規則：直接加 -ing（eating）、去 e 加 -ing（making）、重複字尾加 -ing（running, swimming）
不用進行式的動詞：know, like, love, want, need, believe, understand, belong 等表狀態的動詞

pastExamQuestions.question: My father _____ the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: every morning 表示每天的習慣，用現在簡單式。主詞 My father 第三人稱單數，動詞加 -s。

pastExamQuestions.question: Be quiet! The baby _____.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: Be quiet! 暗示「現在」寶寶正在睡覺，用現在進行式 is sleeping。

pastExamQuestions.question: I _____ this song. Can you play it again?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: love 是狀態動詞，不能用進行式。不管什麼時候都用簡單式 I love。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 現在簡單式 vs. 進行式是最基礎時態題，找時間副詞是關鍵
solvingSteps: 找時間副詞（every day→簡單式，now→進行式）
檢查主詞人稱決定動詞形式
確認是否為狀態動詞（不用進行式）
代入確認時態和主詞動詞一致
thinkingRules: every/always/usually → 現在簡單式
now/Look!/Listen! → 現在進行式
know/like/love/want 不用進行式

topics.name: 過去簡單式與過去進行式
topics.hook: 「昨天我去了公園」I went to the park yesterday。「我去的時候正在下雨」It was raining when I went. 過去式講已完成的事，過去進行式講當時正在做的事。
coreConcepts: 過去簡單式：表過去已完成的動作。時間副詞：yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020, this morning（如天已過一半）
規則動詞：加 -ed（played）、去 e 加 -d（lived）、子音+y 改 ied（studied）、重複字尾加 -ed（stopped）
不規則動詞三態：go-went-gone、eat-ate-eaten、see-saw-seen、take-took-taken、write-wrote-written
過去進行式：was/were + V-ing，表過去某時正在進行。常搭配 when/while 副詞子句
when vs. while：when + 過去簡單式（短動作），while + 過去進行式（長動作）。When he called, I was studying.

pastExamQuestions.question: I _____ a strange noise when I was walking home last night.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: when I was walking 表過去某時，聽到聲音是瞬間動作用過去簡單式 heard。

pastExamQuestions.question: While my mom _____ dinner, the phone rang.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: While + 過去進行式（長動作），the phone rang 是短動作。While 搭配 was cooking。

pastExamQuestions.question: Tom _____ to Japan with his family two years ago.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: two years ago 是過去時間，用過去簡單式 went。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: when/while 搭配過去式 vs. 過去進行式是經典考型
solvingSteps: 找過去時間標誌（yesterday, ago, last...）
有 when/while 判斷長短動作
when + 短動作（過去簡單式）
while + 長動作（過去進行式）
thinkingRules: ago/yesterday/last → 過去簡單式
when + 過去式, 主詞 + 過去進行式（或反過來）
不規則動詞三態靠背誦，無規則可循

topics.name: 未來式
topics.hook: 「明天我要去看電影」I will go to the movies tomorrow，還是 I am going to go to the movies tomorrow？兩種都可以，但語感不同！
coreConcepts: will + 原形動詞：表示臨時決定、預測、意願。I will help you.（我願意幫你）/ It will rain tomorrow.（預測）
be going to + 原形動詞：表示已計劃好的事或有跡象即將發生。I am going to visit grandma this weekend.（計劃）
will vs. be going to：臨時決定用 will，事先計劃用 be going to。看到烏雲密布 → It's going to rain.（有跡象）
未來式時間副詞：tomorrow, next week, soon, in the future, this weekend
否定與疑問：will not (won't) + V / Will you...? / be not going to + V / Are you going to...?

pastExamQuestions.question: A: It's very hot today. B: I _____ the air conditioner on for you.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 當下決定要開冷氣，臨時決定用 will。will turn on。

pastExamQuestions.question: Look at those dark clouds. It _____ soon.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 看到烏雲（有跡象），即將下雨用 is going to rain。will raining 文法錯誤。

pastExamQuestions.question: We _____ have a school trip next month. I'm so excited!
pastExamQuestions.explanation: next month + 已計劃好的校外教學，用 are going to。也可用 will，但 be going to 更強調已排定。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: will vs. be going to 的語境區分是常見考點
solvingSteps: 找未來時間副詞確認是未來式
判斷是臨時決定還是事先計劃
臨時決定 → will，有計劃/有跡象 → be going to
注意 will 後接原形動詞
thinkingRules: tomorrow/next/soon → 未來式
will 後面一定接原形動詞（不是 will raining）
be going to 也可表示「即將」（有跡象時）

topics.name: 現在完成式
topics.hook: 「你吃過日本料理嗎？」Have you ever eaten Japanese food? 現在完成式不是在問「什麼時候吃的」，而是「有沒有這個經驗」——它連結過去和現在！
coreConcepts: 公式：have/has + 過去分詞（Vpp）。I have lived here for 10 years.
表經驗：ever/never/before。Have you ever been to Japan? I have never seen snow before.
表持續：since + 時間點 / for + 一段時間。She has studied English since 2018. / for 6 years.
表完成：already（已經）/ yet（還沒/已經？）/ just（剛剛）。I have already finished. Have you eaten yet?
現在完成式 vs. 過去式：完成式不能搭配明確過去時間（yesterday, ago, last week）。I saw him yesterday. ✓ / I have seen him yesterday. ✗

pastExamQuestions.question: A: Have you _____ the new movie? B: Yes, I saw it last weekend.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: Have you + Vpp（過去分詞）。see 的過去分詞是 seen。回答用 saw 是因為有明確過去時間 last weekend。

pastExamQuestions.question: My family has lived in this town _____ 2010.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: since + 時間點（2010年），for + 一段時間。has lived 是現在完成式，表從2010年住到現在。

pastExamQuestions.question: I have known Amy _____ five years. She is my best friend.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: for + 一段時間（five years）。have known 現在完成式表示認識了五年且持續到現在。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 現在完成式是國中最重要的進階時態，since/for 和 ever/never 是必考搭配
solvingSteps: 看到 have/has 確認是完成式題
找搭配副詞（ever/never/since/for/already/yet）
確認動詞是否為過去分詞形式
注意不能搭配明確過去時間
thinkingRules: since + 時間點、for + 一段時間
have + Vpp，不是 have + Ved
現在完成式問經驗（ever），過去式答細節（yesterday）

topics.name: 被動語態
topics.hook: 「這本書是用英文寫的」This book is written in English。不說誰寫的，只講「被寫」——這就是被動語態！
coreConcepts: 公式：be動詞 + 過去分詞（Vpp）。主動：Tom wrote the letter. → 被動：The letter was written by Tom.
各時態被動：現在 → is/are + Vpp（English is spoken here.）、過去 → was/were + Vpp（The window was broken.）
何時用被動：不知道誰做的、不重要誰做的、或強調承受者。如 The bridge was built in 1950.
by + 行為者：行為者已知且重要時用 by。The song was sung by Jay Chou. 行為者不重要則省略。
常見被動表達：be made of/from（由…製成）、be covered with（被…覆蓋）、be known for（以…聞名）

pastExamQuestions.question: This temple _____ over 200 years ago.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 200 years ago 是過去時間，寺廟是「被建造」的，用過去被動 was built。

pastExamQuestions.question: English _____ in many countries around the world.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 英文在很多國家「被說」，表事實用現在式被動 is spoken。

pastExamQuestions.question: The cake _____ by my mother. It's delicious!
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 蛋糕是媽媽「做的」，由 by my mother 可知是被動語態。語境為已完成用 was made。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 被動語態考查學生能否判斷主動/被動關係並正確使用 be + Vpp
solvingSteps: 判斷主詞是「做」動作還是「被做」
被做 → 被動語態 be + Vpp
確認時態（看時間副詞）選正確 be 動詞
有 by 更確定是被動
thinkingRules: 主詞是人/動物通常主動，主詞是物品通常被動
be + Vpp = 被動；be + V-ing = 進行
200 years ago → was built（過去被動）

topics.name: 助動詞
topics.hook: can 是「能」，should 是「應該」，must 是「必須」——這些助動詞後面永遠接原形動詞！搞清楚它們的意思和用法，文法分數就穩了。
coreConcepts: can/could：can 表能力或許可（I can swim.）、could 表過去能力或更禮貌的請求（Could you help me?）
should/had better：should 表建議（You should study harder.）、had better 表警告性建議（You'd better hurry up.）
must/have to：must 表示強烈義務或推測（You must be tired.）、have to 表外在要求（I have to wear a uniform.）
may/might：may 表允許或可能（May I come in? / It may rain.）、might 更不確定
助動詞 + 原形動詞：所有助動詞後面接原形動詞。She can swim. ✓ / She can swims. ✗ / She can swimming. ✗

pastExamQuestions.question: You _____ be quiet in the library. Other people are reading.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 在圖書館應該安靜。should 表示「應該」的建議。

pastExamQuestions.question: A: _____ I use your phone? B: Sure, go ahead.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: May I...? 用於禮貌請求「我可以…嗎？」Must 太強烈，Should 是建議不是請求。

pastExamQuestions.question: You look pale. You _____ go to see a doctor.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 臉色蒼白，最好去看醫生。had better 表「最好」，帶有警告意味。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 助動詞的語意區分是每年穩定出題的考點
solvingSteps: 判斷句意需要哪種語氣（能力/建議/義務/請求）
選出對應的助動詞
確認助動詞後接原形動詞
注意禮貌程度的差異
thinkingRules: 助動詞 + 原形動詞，永遠不變
can/could/may 都可表請求，may最禮貌
must = 一定（推測）或必須（義務）看語境判斷

importance.tip: 句型題每年穩定出2-3題，尤其比較級與疑問句

unitStrategy.examinerPerspective: 透過句型轉換與選擇題測驗學生對基本句型結構的掌握
scoringTips: 熟記五大句型(S+V, S+V+O, S+V+C, S+V+O+O, S+V+O+C)
比較級規則要背熟，注意 than 和 the + 最高級
疑問句的倒裝語序是常考陷阱
commonTraps: 比較級微微加 more 還是加 -er 混淆
附加問句前肯後否規則忽略
There is/are 主詞單複數一致性
unitStrategy.thinkingPath: 看到句型題 → 分析句子結構(S/V/O/C) → 套用對應規則 → 確認語序正確

topics.name: 五大基本句型
topics.hook: 英文句子再複雜，都不出五種基本架構。就像蓋房子，先有骨架才能裝潢——學好五大句型，就能看懂任何句子！
coreConcepts: S+V（主詞+動詞）：Birds fly. The baby is sleeping. 動詞為不及物動詞，不需受詞
S+V+C（主詞+動詞+補語）：She is beautiful. He looks tired. 連綴動詞(be/look/feel/become)後接補語
S+V+O（主詞+動詞+受詞）：I like English. She plays the piano. 及物動詞後需接受詞
S+V+O+O（主詞+動詞+間接受詞+直接受詞）：Mom gave me a gift. = Mom gave a gift to me.
S+V+O+C（主詞+動詞+受詞+受詞補語）：We call him Tom. The news made her happy.

pastExamQuestions.question: The story made everyone _____.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: make + O + C（受詞補語），C用形容詞描述受詞狀態。made everyone happy。

pastExamQuestions.question: My teacher gave _____ a lot of homework yesterday.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: gave + 間接受詞 + 直接受詞。間接受詞用受格 us。

pastExamQuestions.question: The cake smells _____. Can I have some?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: smell 是感官動詞（連綴動詞），後接形容詞 good。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 透過句型結構判斷過空格需要什麼詞性是基本必考考型
solvingSteps: 分析句子結構，找出 S/V/O/C
判斷空格扮演的角色
選出正確詞性的答案
代入檢查句意是否通順
thinkingRules: make/keep/find + O + 形容詞
give/send/show + 人 + 物 = give/send/show + 物 + to + 人
感官動詞 + 形容詞（不是副詞）

topics.name: 疑問句與附加問句
topics.hook: 「You like coffee, don’t you?」這句話不是真的在問你，而是想確認！附加問句的「前肯後否」規則，是會考的經典考點。
coreConcepts: Wh- 疑問句：Who/What/When/Where/Why/How + 助動詞 + S + V? How often do you exercise?
附加問句規則：前肯後否、前否後肯。You are a student, aren't you? / He can't swim, can he?
特殊附加問句：I am → aren't I? / Let's → shall we? / 祈使句 → will you?
How 系列問句：How many(可數)/How much(不可數/價錢)/How often(頻率)/How long(時間長度)/How far(距離)
間接問句應用：直接問 Where is he? → 間接 I don't know where he is.（詳見子句單元）

pastExamQuestions.question: Your sister works in a hospital, _____?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 前面肯定句 works，附加問句用否定 doesn't she。動詞是 works，助動詞用 does。

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ do you go to the library? — About twice a week.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 回答 twice a week（頻率），用 How often 問頻率。

pastExamQuestions.question: Let's go shopping this afternoon, _____?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: Let's 的附加問句固定用 shall we?。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 附加問句和 How 系列問句是每年必考的句型題
solvingSteps: 附加問句：看前句肯定/否定，後面反過來
找前句的助動詞或 be 動詞
沒有助動詞則用 do/does/did
How 問句看回答判斷用哪個
thinkingRules: 前肯後否、前否後肯
Let's → shall we? / 祈使句 → will you?
I am → aren't I?（特殊）

topics.name: 祈使句與感嘆句
topics.hook: 「Don’t run!」「What a beautiful day!」一個是命令、一個是情感爆發——祈使句和感嘆句是英文中最直接的表達方式！
coreConcepts: 肯定祈使句：原形動詞開頭。Open the door. / Be quiet. / Please sit down.
否定祈使句：Don't + 原形動詞。Don't touch it. / Don't be late. / Never give up.
感嘆句 What：What + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + S + V! What a smart boy he is!
感嘆句 How：How + 形容詞/副詞 + S + V! How beautiful the flower is!
Let 祈使句：Let me help you. / Let's go. / Let him try.

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ a wonderful movie it is! I want to see it again.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: What + a + 形容詞 + 名詞！因為有名詞 movie，用 What。

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ run in the hallway. It's dangerous.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 原形動詞。Don't run 表示「不要跑」。

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ nice the weather is today! Let's go for a walk.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: weather 是不可數名詞且強調形容詞 nice，用 How + 形容詞 + S + V!。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 感嘆句 What vs. How 選擇是常考題型
solvingSteps: 看強調的是名詞還是形容詞
有名詞 → What + (a/an) + adj + n
只有形容詞/副詞 → How + adj/adv
祈使句看肯定/否定決定用原形或 Don't
thinkingRules: What a/an + adj + 可數單數名詞
How + adj + S + V（無名詞）
Don't be late — be 動詞的否定祈使句也用 Don't

topics.name: 比較級與最高級
topics.hook: 「Tom 比 John 高」是 Tom is taller than John。「Tom 是全班最高的」是 Tom is the tallest in the class。兩個比用比較級，三個以上用最高級！
coreConcepts: 比較級規則：短字加 -er（taller）、長字加 more（more beautiful）、不規則（good→better、bad→worse）
最高級規則：短字加 -est（tallest）、長字加 most（most beautiful）、不規則（good→best、bad→worst）
比較級 + than：She is smarter than her brother. 最高級前加 the：She is the smartest in her family.
as...as 原級比較：He is as tall as his father.（一樣高）/ not as...as（不如…）
the + 比較級, the + 比較級：The more you practice, the better you get.（愈…愈…）

pastExamQuestions.question: This math test is _____ than the last one. I can't answer most of the questions.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 有 than 表示比較級，difficult 是長字加 more。

pastExamQuestions.question: Jade is _____ student in our class. She always gets the highest score.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: in our class 表示範圍，用最高級 the smartest。

pastExamQuestions.question: The _____ you study, the _____ grades you will get.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: the + 比較級, the + 比較級。hard → harder，good → better。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 比較級與最高級是每年必考的重點文法
solvingSteps: 有 than → 比較級
in/of + 範圍 → 最高級 + the
判斷短字(-er/-est)或長字(more/most)
確認不規則變化(good-better-best)
thinkingRules: than → 比較級，in/of → 最高級
單音節短字加 -er/-est，雙音節以上加 more/most
good-better-best / bad-worse-worst / many-more-most

topics.name: There is/are 與 It is 句型
topics.hook: 「桌上有一本書」是 There is a book on the table，不是 It is a book...。There is/are 說「存在」，It is 說「它是」——分清楚就不會寫錯！
coreConcepts: There is + 單數/不可數名詞：There is a cat under the table. / There is some water in the glass.
There are + 複數名詞：There are three books on the desk. / There are many students in the classroom.
It is + 形容詞 + to V：It is important to study hard.（虛主詞，真主詞是 to study hard）
It is + 時間/天氣/距離：It is 3 o'clock. / It is rainy today. / It is 5 km from here to school.
過去式：There was/were... It was... 未來式：There will be...

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ many people in the park yesterday because the weather was nice.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: many people 是複數，過去式用 There were。

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ is important for students to get enough sleep every day.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: It is + adj + to V，It 是虛主詞，真主詞是 to get enough sleep。

pastExamQuestions.question: There _____ a pen and two books on my desk.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: There is/are 採就近原則，最近的 a pen 是單數，用 is。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: There is/are 的主詞一致性和 It is 虛主詞用法是常考點
solvingSteps: 判斷句意是「存在」還是「它是」
存在 → There is/are，看名詞單複數
虛主詞 → It is + adj + to V
注意就近原則：There is a pen and two books.
thinkingRules: There is/are 後接名詞決定單複數
It is 用於天氣/時間/虛主詞
就近原則：看最近的名詞決定 is/are

importance.tip: 子句題每年穩定出2-3題，尤其關係代名詞與間接問句

unitStrategy.examinerPerspective: 透過連接詞選擇與子句合併測驗學生對複合句的理解
scoringTips: 分清 and/but/or/so 的語意差異
關係代名詞 who/which/that 的先行詞判斷
間接問句用陳述語序是關鍵
commonTraps: 關係代名詞後多加了代名詞
間接問句仍用倒裝語序
混淆 because 和 because of
unitStrategy.thinkingPath: 看到連接詞/子句題 → 分析前後子句關係 → 選出正確連接詞 → 確認語序

topics.name: 對等連接詞
topics.hook: 「我喜歡貓和狗」用 and，「我想去但沒時間」用 but，「你要茶還是咖啡」用 or。三個小字，連接兩個想法！
coreConcepts: and：表示並列、加（I like cats and dogs.）
but：表示轉折、對比（He is short but strong.）
or：表示選擇（Do you want tea or coffee?）否定句中 or 代替 and（I don't like cats or dogs.）
so：表示因果（It rained, so we stayed home.）注意 because 和 so 不能同時用
not only...but also：不但…而且。He is not only smart but also kind. 動詞跟近的主詞一致

pastExamQuestions.question: I was very tired, _____ I still finished my homework.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 前後語意轉折（很累但仍完成），用 but。

pastExamQuestions.question: Hurry up, _____ you will be late for school.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 「快點，否則你會遲到」祈使句 + or 表示「否則」。

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ it rained heavily, we didn't go out.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 因為下大雨所以沒出門。Because 引導原因子句。注意不能寫 Because...so...。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 連接詞選擇是基礎但高頻的考點
solvingSteps: 分析前後子句的邏輯關係
並列→and，轉折→but，選擇/否則→or，結果→so
注意 because 和 so 不能同時出現
祈使句 + or 表示「否則」
thinkingRules: because 和 so 互斥，只能用一個
祈使句 + and = 就會… / 祈使句 + or = 否則…
not only...but also 動詞跟 but also 後的主詞一致

topics.name: 從屬連接詞
topics.hook: 「如果明天下雨，我們就不去」If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.「雖然他很小，但很勇敢」Although he is small, he is brave. 從屬連接詞讓句子更豐富！
coreConcepts: 時間：when(當)、before(在…之前)、after(在…之後)、while(當…的時候)、until(直到)、as soon as(一…就)
條件：if(如果)、unless(除非=if...not)。條件句用現在式代替未來式：If it rains tomorrow... (不用 will rain)
讓步：although/though(雖然)。注意 although 和 but 不能同時用！Although he is tired, he keeps working. (不加 but)
原因：because(因為)、since(既然)。because vs. because of：because + 子句 / because of + 名詞
目的：so that(以便於)。He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.

pastExamQuestions.question: _____ he is only 12 years old, he can speak three languages.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 雖然只有12歲但能說三種語言，前後語意轉折用 Although。

pastExamQuestions.question: If it _____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: if 條件句用現在式代替未來式。主詞 it 第三人稱加 -s。

pastExamQuestions.question: We stayed home _____ the heavy rain.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: the heavy rain 是名詞片語，用 because of + 名詞。because + 子句。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: if 條件句的時態和 although/but 互斥是最常設的陷阱
solvingSteps: 判斷前後子句的邏輯關係
選出對應的從屬連接詞
檢查時態：if/when + 現在式（即使語意是未來）
確認不重複：although≠but, because≠so
thinkingRules: if/when/before/after + 現在式代替未來式
although 和 but 互斥、because 和 so 互斥
because + 子句，because of + 名詞

topics.name: 關係代名詞與形容詞子句
topics.hook: 「我認識那個住在隔壁的女孩」I know the girl who lives next door. who 就像膠水一樣，把兩句話黏成一句！
coreConcepts: 關係代名詞 who：代替人。The boy who is reading is my brother.（who 引導形容詞子句修飾 the boy）
關係代名詞 which：代替事物。The book which I bought is interesting.（which 代替 the book）
關係代名詞 that：可代替人或物，用法最廣。The girl that sits next to me is Amy.
who/which/that 當受詞時可省略：The book (which/that) I bought... 當主詞時不可省
whose：所有格。The man whose car is red is my uncle.（車是紅色的那個人）

pastExamQuestions.question: The woman _____ is wearing a red dress is my aunt.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: woman 是人，關係代名詞用 who。who is wearing 修飾 the woman。

pastExamQuestions.question: I like the cake _____ my grandmother made for me.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: cake 是物，用 which。which my grandmother made 修飾 the cake。此處 which 當受詞可省略。

pastExamQuestions.question: The boy _____ father is a doctor wants to be a doctor, too.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: whose father 表示「他的父親」，whose 是所有格關係代名詞。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 關係代名詞的選擇是子句單元最重要的考點
solvingSteps: 找先行詞（被修飾的名詞）
判斷人或物：人→who，物→which，所有格→whose
檢查關係代名詞在子句中的角色（主詞/受詞）
受詞位置的 who/which/that 可省略
thinkingRules: 先行詞是人→who/that，是物→which/that
後面已有主詞→關係代名詞當受詞（可省）
後面缺主詞→關係代名詞當主詞（不可省）

topics.name: 間接問句與名詞子句
topics.hook: 「他住哪裡？」Where does he live? → 「我不知道他住哪裡」I don’t know where he lives. 注意到了嗎？間接問句用「陳述語序」！
coreConcepts: 間接問句是把問句放進另一個句子裡，當名詞子句用。Do you know + where he lives?（不是 where does he live）
語序變化：直接問 Where does he live? → 間接 where he lives（去掉助動詞 does，動詞變回三単）
Wh- 間接問句：I wonder what he wants. / Tell me where she went. / I don't know why he is late.
Yes/No 間接問句用 if/whether：Do you know if/whether he is coming?（你知道他是否會來嗎）
that 名詞子句：I think (that) he is right. / I hope (that) you can come. that 可省略

pastExamQuestions.question: Can you tell me where _____?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 間接問句用陳述語序：where + S + V。where the post office is。

pastExamQuestions.question: I don't know _____ he will come to the party or not.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: or not 提示「是否」，用 whether。whether...or not 是固定搭配。

pastExamQuestions.question: Do you know what time _____?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 間接問句用陳述語序：what time + S + V。the movie starts。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 間接問句的語序轉換是最常考的陷阱題
solvingSteps: 確認是間接問句（問句嵌入在句子裡）
用陳述語序：疑問詞 + S + V
去掉助動詞 do/does/did，動詞恢復原形或加三單
是否問句用 if/whether
thinkingRules: 間接問句 = 疑問詞 + S + V（陳述語序）
有 or not → 用 whether
I think/believe/hope + (that) + S + V

importance.tip: 不定詞/動名詞、使役動詞每年1-2題

unitStrategy.examinerPerspective: 透過特殊動詞搭配和句型測驗學生對進階文法的掌握
scoringTips: 背熟接不定詞和動名詞的動詞分類
使役動詞 + O + V原形 規則要熟
太…而不能 / 夠…可以 句型要能互換
commonTraps: 忘記使役動詞後用原形動詞
混淆 stop to V / stop V-ing
unitStrategy.thinkingPath: 看到特殊動詞/句型 → 回想搭配規則 → 判斷接不定詞或動名詞 → 代入檢查

topics.name: 不定詞與動名詞
topics.hook: 「I enjoy swimming」但是「I want to swim」——為什麼一個用 V-ing、一個用 to V？因為每個動詞「喜歡」的后綴不一樣！
coreConcepts: 不定詞 to V：表目的、未來、意願。I want to go. / I decided to study abroad. / I hope to see you.
V-ing 動名詞：表已在做、習慣、一般活動。I enjoy reading. / I finished doing homework. / I practice playing piano.
接 to V 的動詞：want, hope, decide, plan, learn, agree, promise, need, would like
接 V-ing 的動詞：enjoy, finish, practice, mind, avoid, keep, give up, spend time
意思不同：stop to V(停下來去做) vs. stop V-ing(停止做) / remember to V(記得要去做) vs. remember V-ing(記得做過)

pastExamQuestions.question: I enjoy _____ music in my free time. It makes me feel relaxed.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: enjoy + V-ing。enjoy listening to music。enjoy 後不接 to V。

pastExamQuestions.question: Tom decided _____ harder for the final exam.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: decide + to V。decide to study harder 「決定更努力讀書」。

pastExamQuestions.question: Please remember _____ the door when you leave.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: remember to V 表示「記得要去做」。remember V-ing 表示「記得做過」。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 不定詞 vs. 動名詞是進階文法的核心考點
solvingSteps: 找出前面的動詞（want/enjoy/decide等）
回想該動詞接 to V 還是 V-ing
若是 stop/remember 等雙用動詞，看語意判斷
代入確認語意通順
thinkingRules: want/hope/decide/plan/learn → to V
enjoy/finish/practice/mind/avoid → V-ing
stop to V(停下來去做) vs. stop V-ing(停止做)

topics.name: 使役動詞與感官動詞
topics.hook: 「媽媽叫我打掃房間」Mom made me clean my room. 為什麼不是 made me to clean？因為使役動詞後面要用原形動詞！
coreConcepts: 使役動詞 make/let/have + O + V原形：Mom made me clean. / Let me go. / I'll have him call you.
make + O + adj：The news made her happy.（使某人變得…）
get + O + to V：I got him to help me.（get 用 to V，不用原形）
感官動詞 see/hear/watch/feel + O + V原形/V-ing：I saw him cross the street.(看到全程) / I saw him crossing the street.(看到正在過)
被動中的使役動詞：make 被動加 to。I was made to clean my room.（被迫打掃）

pastExamQuestions.question: The teacher made the students _____ the test again.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: make + O + V原形。made the students take。使役動詞後不加 to。

pastExamQuestions.question: I heard someone _____ for help last night.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 感官動詞 hear + O + V原形，表示聽到全程。heard someone call for help。

pastExamQuestions.question: My parents don't let me _____ up late on school nights.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: let + O + V原形。let me stay up late。let 是使役動詞。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 使役動詞和感官動詞後接原形動詞是每年必考
solvingSteps: 辨識出使役/感官動詞
make/let/have → O + V原形
see/hear/watch/feel → O + V原形 或 V-ing
注意 get + O + to V（例外）
thinkingRules: make/let/have + O + V原形（不加 to）
get + O + to V（要加 to）
被動：be made + to V（被動要加回 to）

topics.name: too…to / so…that / enough to 句型
topics.hook: 「這個箱子太重了，我搬不動」The box is too heavy to carry. 「他多才多藝，足以勝任」He is talented enough to win. 三種句型可以互換！
coreConcepts: too + adj/adv + to V：太…而不能…。He is too young to drive.（他太年輕，不能開車）
so + adj/adv + that + S + V：如此…以至於…。He is so young that he can't drive.
adj/adv + enough + to V：夠…可以…。He is old enough to drive.（他夠大可以開車）
enough 的位置：形容詞/副詞 + enough（tall enough），但 enough + 名詞（enough money）
互換：too young to = so young that...can't = not old enough to

pastExamQuestions.question: The tea is _____ hot to drink. Let's wait for a few minutes.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: too hot to drink 表示「太燙而不能喝」。too...to 句型。

pastExamQuestions.question: The movie was _____ boring that many people left early.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: so + adj + that + S + V。so boring that many people left。

pastExamQuestions.question: Is this room big _____ for twenty people?
pastExamQuestions.explanation: adj + enough + for：big enough for twenty people。注意 enough 放在形容詞後。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: too...to 和 so...that 的互換是常考句型轉換題
solvingSteps: 判斷語意：太…而不能 / 如此…以至於 / 夠…可以
選擇對應句型
注意 enough 的位置（adj + enough，enough + n）
互換時注意肯定/否定轉換
thinkingRules: too...to = so...that...can't = not...enough to
enough 接形容詞放後面，接名詞放前面
so + adj，such + n：so beautiful / such a beautiful day

topics.name: 假設語氣基礎
topics.hook: 「如果我是鳥，我就能飛」If I were a bird, I could fly. 為什麼用 were 不用 was？因為這是「與現實相反」的假設！
coreConcepts: 與現在事實相反：If + S + 過去式, S + would/could + V。If I had money, I would buy it.
be 動詞一律用 were：If I were you, I would study harder.（不管主詞是誰都用 were）
wish + 過去式：I wish I were taller.（希望我更高，但事實上不是）
If I were you… 給建議：If I were you, I would see a doctor.（如果我是你，我會去看醫生）
國中範圍僅考基本假設（與現在相反），不考與過去相反的假設語氣

pastExamQuestions.question: If I _____ you, I would apologize to her right away.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞一律用 were。If I were you。

pastExamQuestions.question: I wish I _____ a bird. Then I could fly anywhere.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: wish + 過去式表示與現實相反的願望。be 用 were。

pastExamQuestions.question: If Tom _____ more time, he would travel around the world.
pastExamQuestions.explanation: 與現在相反的假設，if 子句用過去式 had。主要子句用 would + V。

examStrategy.examinerThinking: 假設語氣在國中僅考基本型，抓住 were 和 would 就能拿分
solvingSteps: 判斷是否與現實相反
與現實相反 → if + 過去式, would/could + V
所有人稱的 be 動詞都用 were
wish + 過去式（同一規則）
thinkingRules: If I were you 是固定用法，永遠 were
would/could + 原形動詞（不是 would + 過去式）
國中範圍只考「與現在相反」的假設
